review_status: classified-by-content-and-source; application integration not yet approved
principles: Keep the original archives and extracted source trees unchanged.
Use one shared source asset through references rather than duplicating files across apps.
Do not replace established app logos, watermarks, or brand colors with generic pack icons.
Animated SVG uses SMIL; Android apps should use a tested raster/vector/Lottie conversion rather than assuming native SVG animation support.

application_map.scope: Restaurant and cafe functional icons: menu, food, coffee, cart, orders, delivery, payment, table, profile, and shared controls.
application_map.caveat: The pack uses orange/gold glossy tiles, while Almalaki's current visual identity includes emerald elements. Treat as optional library assets; do not replace the current app logo, banners, or established emerald styling.

application_map.scope: TV playback, channel navigation, live, guide, remote, cast, source, volume, mute, lock, timer, and common TV controls.
application_map.caveat: Functional icon set only. It is not a verified ROYAL TV brand logo or complete screen design.

application_map.scope: Reuse the same TV controls as ROYAL TV through shared references; do not make a second copy of the source files.
application_map.caveat: The pack does not contain a dedicated RS TV / Sinjar brand mark, watermark, or channel-country flag system.

application_map.scope: 16 launcher navigation/content icons, each supplied as static, animated, and focused states.
application_map.caveat: This is the strongest direct match in the package. Keep all three states; use focused state for TV remote selection. The duplicate second archive is byte-identical and should be treated as a backup, not a second variant.

application_map.scope: Only the media-control subset: play, pause, stop, next, previous, forward, rewind, volume up/down, and mute.
application_map.caveat: No dedicated ROYAL AUDIO identity, soundscape artwork, or audio-category icon set is present. These are controls only and do not introduce voice/audio content.

application_map.scope: Potential generic admin controls: settings, profile, login/logout, notifications, search, calendar, clock, check, edit, delete, lock, network, and status controls.
application_map.caveat: No dedicated developer, build, release, signing, owner-code, or dashboard icon family is present. Do not present these generic symbols as RAMI branding.
